scripts.test:full: dotnet r servers coverage:clean && { dotnet r coverage:run; tests=$?; dotnet r coverage:report coverage:open; exit $tests; }
scripts.coverage:open: if [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = vscode ]; then code -r "coverage/index.html"; else $(command -v xdg-open || echo open) "coverage/index.html"; fi
scripts.stryker:redis: dotnet r servers && cd test/Anarchon.Redis.Tests && NoCoverlet=true dotnet stryker --config-file ../../stryker-config.json
scripts.stryker:postgres: dotnet r servers && cd test/Anarchon.Postgres.Tests && NoCoverlet=true dotnet stryker --config-file ../../stryker-config.json
scripts.stryker:nats: dotnet r servers && cd test/Anarchon.Nats.Tests && NoCoverlet=true dotnet stryker --config-file ../../stryker-config.json
scripts.stryker:rabbitmq: dotnet r servers && cd test/Anarchon.RabbitMQ.Tests && NoCoverlet=true dotnet stryker --config-file ../../stryker-config.json
scripts.stryker:backends: dotnet r stryker:sqlite stryker:sql stryker:redis stryker:postgres stryker:nats stryker:rabbitmq
scripts.stryker:open: report=$(ls -1t test/*/StrykerOutput/*/reports/mutation-report.html 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); [ -n "$report" ] || { echo 'No Stryker report yet: run dotnet r stryker'; exit 1; }; if [ "$TERM_PROGRAM" = vscode ]; then code -r "$report"; else $(command -v xdg-open || echo open) "$report"; fi
